hero.title: The aesthetics
hero.description: Step into an interior where every detail tells a story of luxury and seclusion. AURUM is a space for those who value quiet and impeccable style.

mainHall.title: Main dining room
mainHall.caption: An elegant main room that blends contemporary design, warmth, and comfort for every guest.
mainHall.sideText: Warm amber light, velvet tones in the seating, and a calm rhythm—everything feels residential luxury, not cold hotel gloss.

secondHall.title: Second dining perspective
secondHall.lead: Another angle on the same space—distinct from the bar and VIP zones.
secondHall.imageAlt: Second perspective of the AURUM dining room

bar.title: The bar
bar.text: A contemporary bar with a welcoming mood, signature drinks, and a comfortable place to linger.
bar.bullet2: Soft lighting and intimate seating at the counter

vipMain.title: VIP rooms
vipMain.subtitle: Absolute privacy
vipMain.overlayText: Our VIP rooms are designed for comfort and private dining.

terrace.title: Summer terrace
terrace.text: The AURUM terrace is ideal for evening gatherings, meetings, and open-air dinners.

cta.title: Touch the legend
cta.subtitle: Reserve a table at AURUM and discover a new level of hospitality.

VirtualTour.title: Explore the AURUM interior
VirtualTour.text: Walk through the dining room and VIP areas at your own pace. A full 360° tour will appear here soon—for now, set the mood for your next visit.
VirtualTour.dialogText: We are connecting a 2GIS / 360° panorama. If you need a walkthrough now, our host can guide you during your reservation.

Delivery.lead: Enjoy AURUM dishes and drinks at home. We prepare your order and deliver across Almaty on your schedule—with premium packaging and temperature control.
Delivery.why1Title: You want your order quickly and piping hot
Delivery.why1Text: Thermal packaging and courier logistics keep dishes as close to the restaurant experience as possible.
Delivery.why2Title: You prefer not to cook tonight
Delivery.why2Text: Let the AURUM kitchen handle the evening—from starters to signature mains.
Delivery.why3Title: You want to relax at home with restaurant-level food
Delivery.why3Text: Premium service without leaving home—for quiet evenings and gatherings.
Delivery.why4Title: You are hosting a celebration or a simple special night
Delivery.why4Text: We assemble sets and presentation for the occasion—from an intimate dinner to a family table.

DeliveryForm.title: Checkout
DeliveryForm.intro: Fill in your details—the manager will confirm your order. Online payment via Kaspi.kz.
DeliveryForm.paymentNote: Primary payment is Kaspi.kz (button on the right). Card fields below are optional if an alternative is required.
DeliveryForm.successMessage: Our team will contact you to confirm.
DeliveryForm.validationError: Please fill in name, phone, address, and order items.
DeliveryForm.emptyCartHint: Add dishes from the Menu page — they will appear here automatically.

Reviews.title: Guest reviews
Reviews.intro: Reviews focused on atmosphere and quality—to ease uncertainty and help you choose the right visit format.

1.author: Anna Skorova
1.text: “Incredible atmosphere and flawless service. AURUM’s kitchen is true art that removes the fear of the unknown: everything feels predictably premium.”

2.author: Elena Muratova
2.text: “Where privacy meets luxury. Perfect for business meetings and romantic evenings—quality and atmosphere are top tier.”

3.author: Dmitry Kaliyev
3.text: “The cocktail menu is inspiring. Every drink tells a story, and the team is attentive to details.”

4.author: Maria Tleubergen
4.text: “We celebrated an anniversary—service was impeccable, dishes bold and memorable. We will definitely return.”
